title: AXI Liveness Failure: Circular READY Policies
description: WVALID and BVALID remain asserted correctly, but cross-channel destination policies hold WREADY and BREADY LOW forever, producing no accepting edge.

annotations.message: Both channel sources assert VALID without waiting for READY and hold their payloads stable, satisfying the channel safety rule.
The slave's W destination withholds WREADY until the old B response is accepted; the master's B destination withholds BREADY until W data is accepted.
No W or B transfer occurs because neither channel ever has VALID and READY HIGH together.
This is a system-level liveness design failure. The shown READY policies are individually permitted by the handshake rules, so a progress contract or timeout is needed to detect the deadlock.
Debug the dependency graph, not only signal stability: WREADY waits for BREADY while BREADY waits for WREADY.
